name: The Water Cycle
description: How water travels between the sky, the land and the sea.

cards.back: Water heats up and turns into water vapour (a gas).
cards.hint: Think of a puddle disappearing on a sunny day.

cards.back: Water vapour cools down and turns back into tiny droplets, forming clouds.
Water falling from clouds as rain, snow, sleet or hail.
Water gathers in oceans, lakes, rivers and underground.

cards.front: What gives the water cycle its energy?

cards.back: Plants release water vapour through their leaves.
Water stored underground in soil and rocks.
Water that flows over the land into rivers and streams.
